features.name: terraced arena relief
features.notes: Stepped terrain with strong elevation and no overhangs
features.quote: Terraced Arena: Stepped or terraced relief — strong elevation, nothing overhanging.

features.name: central ruined castle keep
features.notes: Large central focal point and highest ground
features.quote: A central ruined castle keep — a large stone tower with broken walls, missing sections, and debris.

features.name: broken keep walls
features.notes: Missing sections and spilled debris around tower
features.quote: a large stone tower with broken walls, missing sections, and debris

features.name: collapsed outer wall ring
features.notes: Defines arena boundary; mixture of intact standing sections and crumbled sections
features.quote: Surrounding broken castle walls — partially collapsed stone walls with gaps and rubble, providing cover and defining the arena boundary.

features.name: rubble choked wall gaps
features.notes: Along routes between outer ring and center
features.quote: Rubble-choked gaps in the collapsed curtain walls and ruined doorways into the keep

features.name: ruined keep doorways
features.quote: ruined doorways into the keep, funnelling fighters into predictable flashpoints

features.name: scattered ruined stone buildings
features.notes: Several small collapsed structures around map
features.quote: Several small ruined buildings — collapsed stone huts and structures scattered around the map

features.name: stone debris piles
features.notes: Broken stone blocks scattered across ground as low cover
features.quote: Stone rubble and debris piles — broken stone blocks scattered across the ground for low cover.

features.name: cracked stone arena floor
features.quote: A cracked stone ground/floor platform as the base of the arena.

features.name: broken pillars and archways
features.notes: Scattered architectural remnants with tall standing elements
features.quote: Broken pillars and archways — remnants of old architecture that provide verticality and cover.

features.name: screened wall platforms
features.notes: Tucked behind intact outer-wall sections and screened from central keep
features.quote: Spawn platforms tucked behind the intact sections of the outer castle wall, screened from the keep's high ground.

features.name: gloomy mossy color palette
features.quote: dark color palette (grays, dark greens, browns)
